scenarios.journey: Log in, add a book to the collection, then log out
scenarios.preconditions: A saved test account for this browser. If "Git Pocket Guide" is already in its collection, the test removes it first.
scenarios.testData: Saved test account for each browser; book "Git Pocket Guide"
steps: Open the Login page and log in with the saved test account
Open the Book Store page and click "Git Pocket Guide"
Remove "Git Pocket Guide" from the collection again
scenarios.expected: After logging in you are on the Profile page. Adding the book shows "Book added to your collection." and the book is listed on the Profile page. Removing it shows "Book deleted." and the collection is empty again. After logging out you are back on the Login page.
scenarios.risk: Login or the collection not working would block every signed-in use of the book store.

testData.notes: One saved account per browser so the three browsers do not share a collection.
Removed before and after the test.

risks.description: DemoQA is a public practice site and can be slow.
risks.mitigation: Wait for the page and account data, never fixed delays.
